lines.title: Lange Lift Manual Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Foot-pump hydraulic lift tables with a rotating deck, Lange Lift's original design built since 1934.
lines.content:
Manual lift tables are Lange Lift's flagship product, made since 1934 and first used as die-handling carts. A foot pump raises the table, and a second pedal lowers it for offloading or seated work, so no power supply is needed.

Tables come with a square deck, rated from 1,000 to 4,000 lb, or a round deck rated from 1,000 to 2,000 lb. Both lower to 27 in. and raise to 45 in., giving 18 in. of vertical travel.
key_features: Foot-pump hydraulic lift, no power required
Square or round deck
Deck rotates 360 degrees and locks at any height
27 in. lowered, 45 in. raised, 18 in. travel
Two swivel and two rigid casters with a foot-operated floor lock
Built in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin

lines.title: Lange Lift Electric Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: 120V electric-over-hydraulic lift tables with 24 to 48 in. decks, rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
Lange Lift's electric tables are built for high-cycle work where lifting and lowering speed matters. A 120V AC motor drives the hydraulics from a standard outlet, and guarded dual foot switches raise and lower the table. A hand-adjustable valve sets the lowering speed.

Square decks come in 24, 30, 36 and 48 in. sizes, each rated from 1,000 to 5,000 lb. Every table lowers to 27 in. and raises to 45 in. Model numbers encode the configuration: the L-136-EP is the 1,000 lb table with a 36 in. deck.
key_features: 120V AC electric-over-hydraulic power
Guarded dual foot switch controls
24, 30, 36 and 48 in. square decks
Adjustable lowering speed
Deck rotates 360 degrees and locks at any height
27 in. lowered, 45 in. raised, 18 in. travel

lines.title: Lange Lift Battery Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Cordless battery-powered hydraulic lift tables for areas without outlets, with 24 to 48 in. decks.
lines.content:
Lange Lift's battery tables suit work away from electrical outlets, including outdoors. An onboard DC motor raises the table, which lowers by gravity at a speed set by a hand-adjustable valve. Controls are on a coil-cord pendant that reaches about 10 ft, and the base-mounted charger plugs into a standard 110V outlet.

Square decks come in 24, 30, 36 and 48 in. sizes, each rated from 1,000 to 5,000 lb, with a 27 in. lowered height and 45 in. raised height.
key_features: Onboard battery and DC motor, no cords or hoses in use
Coil-cord pendant control reaching about 10 ft
Base-mounted charger for a standard 110V outlet
24, 30, 36 and 48 in. square decks
Deck rotates 360 degrees and locks at any height
27 in. lowered, 45 in. raised, 18 in. travel
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Lange Lift Air Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Air-over-hydraulic lift tables for spray booths and combustible environments, with 24 to 48 in. decks.
lines.content:
Lange Lift's air-powered tables are made for spray booths and other combustible environments where electrical equipment is not allowed. An air motor drives the hydraulic ram, controlled by a foot-operated air valve pedal. Lange recommends shop air at 80 PSI and 50 CFM, and an onboard filter, regulator and lubricator conditions the supply.

Square decks come in 24, 30, 36 and 48 in. sizes, each rated from 1,000 to 5,000 lb, with a 27 in. lowered height and 45 in. raised height.
key_features: Air-over-hydraulic power, no electrical components
Foot-operated air valve pedal
Recommended supply: 80 PSI at 50 CFM
24, 30, 36 and 48 in. square decks
Deck rotates 360 degrees and locks at any height
27 in. lowered, 45 in. raised, 18 in. travel

lines.title: Lange Lift Modified & Custom Lifts
lines.excerpt: Lange Lift tables modified or custom-built for specific applications, from 100 to 10,000 lb.
lines.content:
Any Lange Lift table can be modified for a specific application, and the company also builds custom scissor lifts, tilters and upenders, box dumpers, lift carts and turntables. Capacities range from 100 to 10,000 lb across manual, electric, battery and air power.

Options include round and machined decks, ball transfers, roller conveyors, deck covers, tooling slots, tilting decks, powered rotation, alternative casters, and floor-mounted stationary versions.
key_features: Modifications to any standard Lange table
Custom scissor lifts, tilters, box dumpers, lift carts and turntables
Tilting decks, powered rotation, ball transfers and roller conveyors
Floor-mounted stationary versions available

products.title: Lange Lift 24-Inch Manual Hydraulic Lift Table
products.excerpt: Mobile manual post lift table with a 24 in. square rotating deck, rated 1,000–4,000 lb, models L-124 to L-424.
products.content:
This Lange Lift table has a 24 in. square steel deck, the most compact standard deck, suited to smaller parts, dies and fixtures and to tight working areas. It is offered with manual power in 4 capacities from 1,000 to 4,000 lb, and every model lifts from 27 in. to 45 in.

A foot pump raises the deck and a second pedal lowers it, so the table needs no power supply and can be used anywhere it can be rolled. The deck rotates a full 360 degrees and locks at any height, and the table rolls on two rigid and two swivel cast iron casters with a foot-operated floor lock. Model numbers encode the configuration: in L-124, the first digit is the capacity in thousands of pounds and the next two are the deck size.
specs: 24 in square, formed and welded steel
24 in square, formed steel legs, welded steel frame
360 degrees, continuous, with lock handle at any height
5 in cast iron, 2 rigid and 2 swivel
